scripts.setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/api" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/web
